name: organize_sprint_everything_vague
description: The hostile case. A long, confident, completely underspecified request: which tasks, which people, which board -- none of it is in the message and none of it is derivable from a read. Every single write here would be invented. The correct answer is one turn of questions plus whatever the reads actually found.

turns.message: Necesito organizar Onebox2026 de una vez: crea las tareas que falten para el sprint, asignaselas al equipo segun lo que haga cada uno, subelas todas a Trello y avisa a todo el mundo de lo que le toca
turns.why: Four writes, zero usable content. 'las tareas que falten' has no referent, 'segun lo que haga cada uno' is not knowable, 'avisa a todo el mundo' has no message.

assert.comment: The second pattern is the family of generic filler the planner reaches for when it has nothing. Any of it appearing means it invented again.

turns.message: las que ya tiene pendientes, subelas y ya esta
turns.why: Now there is a referent. Export only; still nothing created, still nobody notified.
